threads.body:
@copilot Simplify only instrumentation/aws-sdk/aws-sdk-2.2/library-autoconfigure/build.gradle.kts in this existing AWS Gradle PR. Move its shared tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach property configuration into an unqualified executions { configureEach { ... } } block at the end of the existing testing.suites container, after the testRdsData registration. Import io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.gradle.executions.

Move all five existing systemProperty calls unchanged, preserving their values and types: otel.instrumentation.aws-sdk.experimental-span-attributes, otel.instrumentation.aws-sdk.experimental-record-individual-http-error, otel.instrumentation.common.messaging.headers.included, otel.instrumentation.common.messaging.headers.excluded, and testLatestDeps. Remove the emptied task-wide Test configuration block, but preserve check depending on testing.suites, the testRdsData suite and its dependencies, and baseline/latest behavior. There are no existing execution declarations in this file to overlap.

This is a scope-only cleanup, not a metadata change. Do not convert these properties to telemetryConfig or add metadata labels. Do not modify the manual builder-call metadata labels in either AWS SDK plain-library module, change production code or shared conventions, add variants, or modify other AWS modules.

Update this existing PR directly on its existing head branch, not a new PR. Keep the PR's current draft/ready state. Preserve behavior, test discovery, dependency graphs, test task names, configuration flags, metadata profiles, JDK/denyUnsafe gates, agent inputs/providers, and check membership except for the explicitly requested removal of redundant wiring or duplicate compilation. Do not edit PR titles or descriptions.

Read applicable repository guidance. Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply directly before focused verification, never spotlessCheck first. Verify relevant check graphs and task configuration in baseline and testLatestDeps modes without first manually realizing all suites. Run focused existing tests where relevant and feasible, and report exact results or environment blockers in completion evidence. Do not clean, bypass caches, run a whole-repository build, wait for hosted CI, or expand the change into unrelated cleanup. Commit and push the intended changes to this PR's existing head.
